profile.headline: Software Engineering Lead | Agile design and development | Mentor | Backend Java |
profile.summary: Detail-oriented, top performing software engineer with over fifteen years of experience in information technology in regulated medical software, telecommunications, and insurance industries. Major strengths are in software design and development, problem solving and resolution, and leading and mentoring team members. Consistent, analytical individual with a proven track record in fixing and improving software, and working with customers, internal and external.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development Team Lead for Command Center, a web-based application platform for hospital wide patient care coordination, customer projects. 
  
·          Collaborated with a development team of 2 to 5 engineers in leading the design, testing, and deploying customer-focused distributed production systems.
  
·          Leveraged AI-Supported tools such as GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT Codex to address defects and upgrade application dependencies reducing time spent by 75%.
  
·          Built and maintained production-grade data ingestion applications to parse and insert data in database from over forty sources including JSON rest services and HL7 messaging systems from electronic medical record systems.
  
·          Support validation and verification testing teams by writing over a hundred behavior driven development scenarios and automation testing code.
  
·          Executed validation and verification tests across more than twenty components of the applications to ensure code quality and comply with regulatory requirements, catching multiple defects before release.
  
·          Displayed leadership by guiding over fifteen engineers to learn the architecture of the platform and supporting them in the onboarding process.
positions.insights: Agile Application Development, Object Oriented Design and +12 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
·          Developed over four products in the Hospital of the Future suite of applications as a senior team member. Responsibilities include design and development, support, and leading scrums as needed.
  
·          Created web-based analytics application using the play framework to report on surgeon usage of scheduled hospital resources to ensure maximum usage improving surgical room usage by 15%.
  
·          Designed and maintained cloud based IaaS hosting for multiple products using Microsoft Azure reducing hosting costs by 70%.
  
·          Implemented private network architecture on cloud solution to allow for up to ten customer databases to be hosted on a single server saving several thousands in monthly hosting costs.
positions.insights: Object Oriented Design, Test Automation and +7 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Consulted on-site with performance testing group to bring needed testing to completion within required deadline resulting in software configuration changes for improved performance before customer deployment.
•	Designed, developed and tested XML based data file loader to allow an open interface to inject data from other donation information systems into our product.
•	Designed, developed and tested xml extraction utility to use as XML based configuration file to query an oracle database and generate XML data files based on the query results.
positions.insights: Object Oriented Design, Test Automation and +7 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Championed re-architecting application involving four team members reducing customers’ on-site time by an estimated 25%.
•	Served as architectural resource for solving problems assigned to over 10 engineers on inherited application allowing them to understand the source code in order to resolve defects.
•	Mentored three summer interns and two team members to orient them to the project to increase their productivity within two weeks of starting date.
•	Improved customer’s satisfaction with the application by reducing defect backlog and new defect rate by 95% in 2 years.
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and +1 skill

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Supported thirty users in converting Microsoft Windows platforms and various development duties for implementation of vendor provided pensions administration software.
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and +1 skill

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Coordinated server moves across three hosting services to improve website uptime and save club money on hosting fees. This included editing DNS records to point at multiple hosting services.
•	Championed email forwarding service supporting 10 officers to have a club email address for better email management providing a professional image and experience to members.
•	Designed and developed custom member dues application using PGP encryption and PHP scripts to handle membership renewals from over 500 members providing the first ever online application and renewal for the club.
